I will not buy chemical fertilizer for this 0.12 hectare sorghum plot because a full bag from the cooperative is too much for this small piece and I need to keep my cash for other things. I will spread manure from my oxen on it instead, since I own this land and want to keep the soil good for next years too. I will plant local sorghum seed that I saved from last harvest, and I will not spray pesticides or irrigate — I am counting on the rain. My family will work about 18 days on this plot from planting to threshing, and I will hire no outside labor because we can manage it ourselves.
